instructions: Reads a running Unity game the way a player sees it.
The game answers only while the Unity Editor is in Play Mode with the Agent API opened from the menu Tools/Agent API
(otherwise the tools return no_endpoint or connect).
Call game_hello once first to see which abilities are open, the state of the world and the routes.
Then call game_look to read what is on screen.

tools.name: game_hello
tools.title: Say hello to the game
description: Returns the API version, how the endpoint was opened (open, abilities), the state of the world
(world.state: none, loading, ready or closing), the routes you may call and the signal names.

tools.name: game_look
tools.title: Look at the screen
description: Returns what the player can see right now: the active scene name, the camera name,
and up to 8 objects inside the camera view, nearest first, each with a direction word
(left, center, right) and a distance word (near, mid, far). No coordinates.
